summary: Remote WebSocket relay dispatches arbitrary shell commands on the installer's host
details: When the agent daemon is started, it opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay at vanexa-agent-relay.tubefood.workers.dev and processes decrypted `task_request` messages via an AgentLoop. A registered `terminal_persistent_shell` tool spawns `powershell.exe` on Windows or `$SHELL`/`/bin/zsh` elsewhere with `command` strings sourced from those messages, giving whoever controls the relay arbitrary command execution on the host running the daemon. The primary logic ships as opaque V8 bytecode (dist/bundle.jsc) loaded via `require(bytecodePath)` from dist/bundle.cjs, and the tarball includes a socket.json that sets Socket.dev issueRules to `ignore` for aiMalware, gptMalware, obfuscatedCode, usesEval, nativeCode, shellAccess, filesystemAccess, networkAccess, bypassesEnvironment, and installScripts — a scanner-suppression posture accompanying the remote-shell dataflow. Bundle strings also reference `https://vanexa-installer.vercel.app/install.sh` and `install.ps1` as one-line curl|sh / irm|iex installers hosted on an author-controlled mutable endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
